To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the research cooperation can be described by the citation content/context data, and that it is a promising approach for the future research.

(1) co citation statistics can be used to build a network of research cooperations; (2) spatial distribution of citations can be used to detect research cooperation; (3) topic models can be used to find research cooperation and its character.
the citation content/context data can be successfully used for building the research collaboration indicators/parameters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methods for the automatic analysis of citation content/context and their usage for the research cooperation analysis.
the development of a method for the analysis of citation content and context data.
the analysis of research cooperation, using the citation content/context data as the main data source.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results of our work can help in the analysis and understanding of research cooperation and the research process in general.
the results of our work can be used to support research cooperation analysis and to build the research cooperation characteristics.
the citation context data are a valuable source for research cooperation studies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
citation content/context data can be used to build a research cooperation analysis system.
the citation content/context data is an important source for building the research network characteristics and that this data can be used for the research cooperation analysis.
we have developed an on line service to monitor citation content data and to provide a set of research cooperation indicators/parameters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to build a research cooperation network using the citation content/context data and to use it for the analysis and evaluation of the cooperation.
citation context data is a valuable source of information for research cooperation analysis.
the analysis of citation content/context information is useful in building research cooperation characteristics and can help to improve research collaboration analysis.
